statement: The advective screening kernel preserves cumulative mass balance between emitted mass, retained compartment mass, degraded mass, and advected mass, with negligible closure error across degradation-dominant, clearance-dominant, and mixed-loss regimes.

source_references.title: Fate MCP advective cumulative mass-balance method notes
EPA Guidance on the Development, Evaluation, and Application of Environmental Models

methods_basis_lines: This claim is limited to the governed one-compartment advective screening equation and its cumulative trace accounting at elapsed time.

The claim is satisfied when emitted mass is partitioned into retained compartment mass plus degraded and advected cumulative losses with negligible residual closure error across distinct loss-share regimes.
reference_case_lines: Supported by the advective_degradation_dominant_loss_share_anchor_fixture and companion case for degradation-heavy closure accounting.
Supported by the advective_clearance_dominant_loss_share_anchor_fixture and companion case for clearance-heavy closure accounting.
Supported by the advective_mixed_loss_transition_anchor_fixture and companion case for near-parity cumulative closure accounting.
advective_degradation_dominant_loss_share_anchor_fixture: The advective trace reports degradation as the dominant loss share when half-life is short relative to residence time.

advective_degradation_dominant_loss_share_companion_fixture: The advective trace continues to report degradation as the dominant loss share under a different short-half-life and long-residence regime.
reference_case_concept_lines: ECHA EUSES water screening case family: This governed reference case family anchors one-compartment flowing-water screening interpretations against regulator-recognizable EUSES-style environmental exposure concepts.

EPA flow-through water screening case family: This governed reference case family anchors finite-duration flowing-water screening logic against EPA environmental model guidance for bounded transport and model-use transparency.

Advective clearance edge-condition case family: This governed reference case family anchors the experimental advective screening model at the two reviewer-critical clearance extremes: short residence time and long residence time under effective persistence.
